question: How is the manifest sign distinguished and how do the three signs relate?
premises: The manifest sign is said to consist only of man.
The unmanifest and mixed signs were described as involving Śiva and Śakti.
This threefold division is an arrangement of one single vibration.
inference: The three signs are not separate realities but three structured modes of one vibration.
plain_english: But the manifest sign is said to be that which consists only of man; this threefold division is an arrangement of one single vibration.
